It's incredible. I mean, you know, one of these compact fluoro, this is a standard compact fluoro

circular ones, this is 70 lumens per watt whereas these little tiny itty-bitty Cree

circular fluoros, these T5 circulars, they're better than these compact fluoros in efficiency
